observation.layout: TERM-major: each term contributes its whole history as one contiguous block, then the blocks are concatenated. Within a block, frames run oldest to newest. NOT a sequence of frames.

terms.name: base_lin_vel
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

terms.name: base_ang_vel
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

terms.name: projected_gravity
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

terms.name: wheel_vel
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

terms.name: actions
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

terms.name: command
terms.frame_order: oldest first; the last block is the current step

observation.note: Normalization is baked into the exported graph -- feed raw observations, exactly as listed, in this order. Zero-fill the history on startup; the policy was trained with buffers that start at zero after every reset.

action.units: rad/s after multiplying the network output by `scale`
action.to_odrive_input_vel: input_vel [turn/s] = target [rad/s] / (2*pi); the drivetrain is 1:1, so no gear ratio is applied (SIM2REAL.md sec 3).
